title: Butterfly Lovers
synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.

fullText.simplified:
马文看到小英不听他的话，就要打小英。大山看到了，说：“你不是就想要一个人去外面跑步吗？我去！”说完，他就跑到外面跑步了。
    马文笑了。他坐在教室的椅子上，看着大山跑步，不再说话了。马文看了很长时间，觉得没意思，就走了。马文走后，大山累得坐在了地上。小英跑到大山身边，和大山一起回他的房间了。
    第二天，大山没有去教室上课，因为他生病了。小英一下课就跑去看大山，她看到大山睡在床上，看起来很累。她心想：要是大山昨天不帮我在雨中跑步，就不会生病了。都是我的错！
    大山生病了，不能去上课，也不能去吃饭。小英每天一下课就跑去找大山，帮他买饭，告诉他今天上课上了些什么。小英妈妈说过，不能进男孩子的房间。但是现在小英想不起来她妈妈说过的话了，她只想让大山快点好起来。
    很多天后，大山病好了。他又可以和小英一起上课，一起吃饭，一起看书了。小英很高兴。
    慢慢地，小英觉得她对大山不是哥哥和弟弟那样的喜欢了，是女孩子对男孩子的喜欢。小英觉得她喜欢上大山了。
    小英想告诉大山她喜欢他，但是她不能说，她只能在心里喜欢。大山不知道小英是女孩子，只是觉得小英像他的弟弟一样。哥哥要帮弟弟，所以小英有什么事情他都喜欢帮忙。
    小英心想：现在每天都和大山在一起，告不告诉大山都一样。
    就这样，他们每天一起上课，一起吃饭，一起玩，一起笑。小英觉得每天都很快乐。
    但是，时间不等人，三年很快就到了。周妈妈说了，小英只能在学校三年。现在，三年到了，小英要回家了。
fullText.traditional:
馬文看到小英不聽他的話，就要打小英。大山看到了，說：“你不是就想要一個人去外面跑步嗎？我去！”說完，他就跑到外面跑步了。
    馬文笑了。他坐在教室的椅子上，看著大山跑步，不再說話了。馬文看了很長時間，覺得沒意思，就走了。馬文走後，大山累得坐在了地上。小英跑到大山身邊，和大山一起回他的房間了。
    第二天，大山沒有去教室上課，因為他生病了。小英一下課就跑去看大山，她看到大山睡在床上，看起來很累。她心想：要是大山昨天不幫我在雨中跑步，就不會生病了。都是我的錯！
    大山生病了，不能去上課，也不能去吃飯。小英每天一下課就跑去找大山，幫他買飯，告訴他今天上課上了些什麼。小英媽媽說過，不能進男孩子的房間。但是現在小英想不起來她媽媽說過的話了，她只想讓大山快點好起來。
    很多天後，大山病好了。他又可以和小英一起上課，一起吃飯，一起看書了。小英很高興。
    慢慢地，小英覺得她對大山不是哥哥和弟弟那樣的喜歡了，是女孩子對男孩子的喜歡。小英覺得她喜歡上大山了。
    小英想告訴大山她喜歡他，但是她不能說，她只能在心裡喜歡。大山不知道小英是女孩子，只是覺得小英像他的弟弟一樣。哥哥要幫弟弟，所以小英有什麼事情他都喜歡幫忙。
    小英心想：現在每天都和大山在一起，告不告訴大山都一樣。
    就這樣，他們每天一起上課，一起吃飯，一起玩，一起笑。小英覺得每天都很快樂。
    但是，時間不等人，三年很快就到了。周媽媽說了，小英只能在學校三年。現在，三年到了，小英要回家了。

sentences.simplified: 马文看到小英不听他的话，就要打小英。
sentences.traditional: 馬文看到小英不聽他的話，就要打小英。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ wén kàn dào xiǎo yīng bù tīng tā de huà jiù yào dǎ xiǎo yīng
sentences.english: Ma Wen saw that Xiao Ying wasn’t doing what he said, and was about to beat up Xiao Ying.

sentences.simplified: 大山看到了，说：
sentences.traditional: 大山看到了，說：
sentences.pinyin: dà shān kàn dào le shuō
sentences.english: Dashan saw that, and said:

sentences.simplified: “你不是就想要一个人去外面跑步吗？我去！”
sentences.traditional: “你不是就想要一個人去外面跑步嗎？我去！”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bú shì jiù xiǎng yào yí ge rén qù wài miàn pǎo bù ma wǒ qù
sentences.english: “Don’t you just want someone to go have a jog outside? I’ll go!”

sentences.simplified: 说完，他就跑到外面跑步了。
sentences.traditional: 說完，他就跑到外面跑步了。
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán tā jiù pǎo dào wài miàn pǎo bù le
sentences.english: He finished talking and ran outside to have a jog.

sentences.simplified: 马文笑了。
sentences.traditional: 馬文笑了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ wén xiào le
sentences.english: Ma Wen laughed.

sentences.simplified: 他坐在教室的椅子上，看着大山跑步，不再说话了。
sentences.traditional: 他坐在教室的椅子上，看著大山跑步，不再說話了。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò zài jiào shì de yǐ zi shang kàn zhe dà shān pǎo bù bú zài shuō huà le
sentences.english: He sat down on a classroom chair, watched Dashan jog, and didn’t say anything more.

sentences.simplified: 马文看了很长时间，觉得没意思，就走了。
sentences.traditional: 馬文看了很長時間，覺得沒意思，就走了。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ wén kàn le hěn cháng shí jiān jué de méi yì si jiù zǒu le
sentences.english: Ma Wen looked for a very long time, thought that it got boring, and left.

sentences.simplified: 马文走后，大山累得坐在了地上。
sentences.traditional: 馬文走後，大山累得坐在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: mǎ wén zǒu hòu dà shān lèi de zuò zài le dì shang
sentences.english: After Ma Wen left, Dashan tiredly sat down on the ground.

sentences.simplified: 小英跑到大山身边，和大山一起回他的房间了。
sentences.traditional: 小英跑到大山身邊，和大山一起回他的房間了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng pǎo dào dà shān shēn biān hé dà shān yì qǐ huí tā de fáng jiān le
sentences.english: Xiao Ying ran up next to Dashan and went back to Dashan’s room together with him.

sentences.simplified: 第二天，大山没有去教室上课，因为他生病了。
sentences.traditional: 第二天，大山沒有去教室上課，因為他生病了。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān dà shān méi yǒu qù jiào shì shàng kè yīn wèi tā shēng bìng le
sentences.english: The next day, Dashan didn’t come to the classroom to attend class, because he had fallen ill.

sentences.simplified: 小英一下课就跑去看大山，她看到大山睡在床上，看起来很累。
sentences.traditional: 小英一下課就跑去看大山，她看到大山睡在床上，看起來很累。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng yí xià kè jiù pǎo qù kàn dà shān tā kàn dào dà shān shuì zài chuáng shang kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi
sentences.english: As soon as class was over Xiao Ying ran to see Dashan. She saw that Dashan was sleeping in bed, looking very tired.

sentences.simplified: 她心想：要是大山昨天不帮我在雨中跑步，就不会生病了。
sentences.traditional: 她心想：要是大山昨天不幫我在雨中跑步，就不會生病了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xīn xiǎng yào shi dà shān zuó tiān bù bāng wǒ zài yǔ zhōng pǎo bù jiù bú huì shēng bìng le
sentences.english: She thought to herself: If Dashan hadn’t helped me yesterday and went jogging in the rain, he wouldn’t have fallen ill.

sentences.simplified: 都是我的错！
sentences.traditional: 都是我的錯！
sentences.pinyin: dōu shì wǒ de cuò
sentences.english: This is all my fault!

sentences.simplified: 大山生病了，不能去上课，也不能去吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 大山生病了，不能去上課，也不能去吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: dà shān shēng bìng le bù néng qù shàng kè yě bù néng qù chī fàn
sentences.english: Dashan was ill, and couldn’t go to class, and also couldn’t go to eat.

sentences.simplified: 小英每天一下课就跑去找大山，帮他买饭，
sentences.traditional: 小英每天一下課就跑去找大山，幫他買飯，
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng měi tiān yí xià kè jiù pǎo qù zhǎo dà shān bāng tā mǎi fàn
sentences.english: Xiao Ying ran to look for Dashan every day as soon as class was over, helped him buy food, ..

sentences.simplified: 告诉他今天上课上了些什么。
sentences.traditional: 告訴他今天上課上了些什麼。
sentences.pinyin: gào su tā jīn tiān shàng kè shàng le xiē shén me
sentences.english: .. and told him what they had learned in class that day.

sentences.simplified: 小英妈妈说过，不能进男孩子的房间。
sentences.traditional: 小英媽媽說過，不能進男孩子的房間。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng mā ma shuō guò bù néng jìn nán hái zi de fáng jiān
sentences.english: Xiao Ying’s mother had said that she couldn’t go into a boy’s room.

sentences.simplified: 但是现在小英想不起来她妈妈说过的话了，
sentences.traditional: 但是現在小英想不起來她媽媽說過的話了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì xiàn zài xiǎo yīng xiǎng bù qǐ lái tā mā ma shuō guò de huà le
sentences.english: But now Xiao Ying didn’t come to think of what her mother had said.

sentences.simplified: 她只想让大山快点好起来。
sentences.traditional: 她只想讓大山快點好起來。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ xiǎng ràng dà shān kuài diǎn hǎo qǐ lái
sentences.english: She only wanted to make Dashan quickly get better.

sentences.simplified: 很多天后，大山病好了。
sentences.traditional: 很多天後，大山病好了。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō tiān hòu dà shān bìng hǎo le
sentences.english: Many days later, Dashan recovered from his illness.

sentences.simplified: 他又可以和小英一起上课，一起吃饭，一起看书了。
sentences.traditional: 他又可以和小英一起上課，一起吃飯，一起看書了。
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu kě yǐ hé xiǎo yīng yì qǐ shàng kè yì qǐ chī fàn yì qǐ kàn shū le
sentences.english: He could go to class together with Xiao Ying again, have meals together, and read together.

sentences.simplified: 小英很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 小英很高興。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: Xiao Ying was very happy.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，小英觉得她对大山不是哥哥和弟弟那样的喜欢了，
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，小英覺得她對大山不是哥哥和弟弟那樣的喜歡了，
sentences.pinyin: màn man de xiǎo yīng jué de tā duì dà shān bú shì gē ge hé dì di nà yàng de xǐ huan le
sentences.english: Slowly, Xiao Ying felt that she didn’t like Dashan the way that brothers do.

sentences.simplified: 是女孩子对男孩子的喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 是女孩子對男孩子的喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: shì nǚ hái zi duì nán hái zi de xǐ huan
sentences.english: It was the way that a girl has feelings for a boy.

sentences.simplified: 小英觉得她喜欢上大山了。
sentences.traditional: 小英覺得她喜歡上大山了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng jué de tā xǐ huan shàng dà shān le
sentences.english: Xiao Ying felt that she had started liking Dashan.

sentences.simplified: 小英想告诉大山她喜欢他，但是她不能说，她只能在心里喜欢。
sentences.traditional: 小英想告訴大山她喜歡他，但是她不能說，她只能在心裡喜歡。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng xiǎng gào su dà shān tā xǐ huan tā dàn shì tā bù néng shuō tā zhǐ néng zài xīn li xǐ huan
sentences.english: Xiao Ying wanted to tell Dashan that she liked him, but she couldn’t say that. She could only like him in her heart.

sentences.simplified: 大山不知道小英是女孩子，只是觉得小英像他的弟弟一样。
sentences.traditional: 大山不知道小英是女孩子，只是覺得小英像他的弟弟一樣。
sentences.pinyin: dà shān bù zhī dào xiǎo yīng shì nǚ hái zi zhǐ shì jué de xiǎo yīng xiàng tā de dì di yí yàng
sentences.english: Dashan didn’t know that Xiao Ying was a girl, and only thought that Xiao Ying was like his little brother.

sentences.simplified: 哥哥要帮弟弟，所以小英有什么事情他都喜欢帮忙。
sentences.traditional: 哥哥要幫弟弟，所以小英有什麼事情他都喜歡幫忙。
sentences.pinyin: gē ge yào bāng dì di suǒ yǐ xiǎo yīng yǒu shén me shì qing tā dōu xǐ huan bāng máng
sentences.english: Older brothers should help younger brothers, so he always liked to help Xiao Ying with whatever might be the matter.

sentences.simplified: 小英心想：
sentences.traditional: 小英心想：
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng xīn xiǎng
sentences.english: Xiao Ying thought to herself:

sentences.simplified: 现在每天都和大山在一起，告不告诉大山都一样。
sentences.traditional: 現在每天都和大山在一起，告不告訴大山都一樣。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài měi tiān dōu hé dà shān zài yì qǐ gào bú gào su dà shān dōu yí yàng
sentences.english: Right now I’m together with Dashan every single day, it’s all the same whether I tell Dashan or not.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，他们每天一起上课，一起吃饭，一起玩，一起笑。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，他們每天一起上課，一起吃飯，一起玩，一起笑。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng tā men měi tiān yì qǐ shàng kè yì qǐ chī fàn yì qǐ wán yì qǐ xiào
sentences.english: So just like this, they went to class together every day, had meals together, had fun together, and laughed together.

sentences.simplified: 小英觉得每天都很快乐。
sentences.traditional: 小英覺得每天都很快樂。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo yīng jué de měi tiān dōu hěn kuài lè
sentences.english: Xiao Ying thought that each and every day was very happy.

sentences.simplified: 但是，时间不等人，三年很快就到了。
sentences.traditional: 但是，時間不等人，三年很快就到了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì shí jiān bù děng rén sān nián hěn kuài jiù dào le
sentences.english: But, time waits for no one, and three years went very quickly.

sentences.simplified: 周妈妈说了，小英只能在学校三年。
sentences.traditional: 周媽媽說了，小英只能在學校三年。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu mā ma shuō le xiǎo yīng zhǐ néng zài xué xiào sān nián
sentences.english: Mother Zhou had said that Xiao Ying could only be at school for three years.

sentences.simplified: 现在，三年到了，小英要回家了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，三年到了，小英要回家了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài sān nián dào le xiǎo yīng yào huí jiā le
sentences.english: Now, it had been three years, and Xiao Ying had to return home.

raw.synopsis: This is our elementary level adaptation of the classic Chinese legend “Butterfly Lovers”.
sentence_translations: Ma Wen saw that Xiao Ying wasn’t doing what he said, and was about to beat up Xiao Ying.
Dashan saw that, and said:
“Don’t you just want someone to go have a jog outside? I’ll go!”
He finished talking and ran outside to have a jog.
Ma Wen laughed.
He sat down on a classroom chair, watched Dashan jog, and didn’t say anything more.
Ma Wen looked for a very long time, thought that it got boring, and left.
After Ma Wen left, Dashan tiredly sat down on the ground.
Xiao Ying ran up next to Dashan and went back to Dashan’s room together with him.
The next day, Dashan didn’t come to the classroom to attend class, because he had fallen ill.
As soon as class was over Xiao Ying ran to see Dashan. She saw that Dashan was sleeping in bed, looking very tired.
She thought to herself: If Dashan hadn’t helped me yesterday and went jogging in the rain, he wouldn’t have fallen ill.
This is all my fault!
Dashan was ill, and couldn’t go to class, and also couldn’t go to eat.
Xiao Ying ran to look for Dashan every day as soon as class was over, helped him buy food, ..
.. and told him what they had learned in class that day.
Xiao Ying’s mother had said that she couldn’t go into a boy’s room.
But now Xiao Ying didn’t come to think of what her mother had said.
She only wanted to make Dashan quickly get better.
Many days later, Dashan recovered from his illness.
He could go to class together with Xiao Ying again, have meals together, and read together.
Xiao Ying was very happy.
Slowly, Xiao Ying felt that she didn’t like Dashan the way that brothers do.
It was the way that a girl has feelings for a boy.
Xiao Ying felt that she had started liking Dashan.
Xiao Ying wanted to tell Dashan that she liked him, but she couldn’t say that. She could only like him in her heart.
Dashan didn’t know that Xiao Ying was a girl, and only thought that Xiao Ying was like his little brother.
Older brothers should help younger brothers, so he always liked to help Xiao Ying with whatever might be the matter.
Xiao Ying thought to herself:
Right now I’m together with Dashan every single day, it’s all the same whether I tell Dashan or not.
So just like this, they went to class together every day, had meals together, had fun together, and laughed together.
Xiao Ying thought that each and every day was very happy.
But, time waits for no one, and three years went very quickly.
Mother Zhou had said that Xiao Ying could only be at school for three years.
Now, it had been three years, and Xiao Ying had to return home.
